captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a utility blimp, featuring a large, cigar-shaped grey envelope. Below the centerline, a dark structural gondola is suspended, carrying twin engine nacelles equipped with propellers. The rear of the blimp features a cruciform tail assembly with vertical and horizontal stabilizers. The rudder on the vertical stabilizer pivots on a vertical hinge, the elevators on the horizontal stabilizers pivot on horizontal hinges, and both propellers rotate continuously on their axles.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a utility blimp using CadQuery. The blimp should feature a large cigar-shaped envelope, a dark structural gondola mounted underneath, twin engine nacelles with rotating propellers, and a cruciform tail assembly. Ensure the rudder and elevators are modeled with functional rotational joints and the propellers have continuous rotational joints.
captions.factory: The blimp is constructed by first creating the main envelope using a loft or revolve of circular profiles along a longitudinal axis. The gondola is modeled as a box-like primitive with filleted edges, positioned below the envelope. The cruciform tail fins are extruded profiles attached at the rear of the envelope, split into fixed stabilizers and movable control surfaces (rudder and elevators) connected via revolute joints. The nacelles and propellers are constructed using cylinders and helical sweeps or lofted blades, attached to the gondola with continuous rotational joints.
